Description:
Creates a MySQL HA cluster:
This template creates a MySQL HA cluster. Prerequisites:
The instance offering, image, and network are created. Make sure that the network can access the Internet, and cloudinit is installed for the image. Otherwise, the cluster may fail to be created.

instanceOfferingUuid.Label: Instance Offering
instanceOfferingUuid.Description: The instance offering for creating a VM.

l3NetworkUuid.Label: Network
l3NetworkUuid.Description: The network for creating a VM. Make sure that the network supports the Userdata service and can access the Internet.

Fn::Join.Fn::Base64:
#cloud-config
users:
 - name: test
   shell: /bin/bash
   groups: users
   sudo: ['ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL']
   ssh-authorized-keys:
    - ssh-rsa  root@10-0-211-214
packages:
 - mariadb
 - mariadb-server

write_files:
 - path: /etc/my.cnf
   content: |
    [mysqld]
    log-bin=mysql-bin
    server-id=111
    datadir=/var/lib/mysql
    socket=/var/lib/mysql/mysql.sock
    symbolic-links=0

    [mysqld_safe]
    log-error=/var/log/mariadb/mariadb.log
    pid-file=/var/run/mariadb/mariadb.pid
    !includedir /etc/my.cnf.d
 - path: /tmp/mysql-setting.sh
   content: |
    iptables -F
    service mariadb start
    mysql -uroot -e  "GRANT REPLICATION SLAVE ON *.* to 'mysync'@'%' identified by 'q123456'"
    mysql -uroot -e  "grant SUPER ON *.* TO mysync"
runcmd:
 - [ bash, /tmp/mysql-setting.sh]
